verdict.rationale: Postman documents a public REST API for programmatic access to its own platform (postman-docs-5) and can generate client SDKs from collections/specs for the APIs being tested (postman-docs-4), plus exposes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (postman-probe-3). However, there is no evidence of official first-party client SDKs (e.g., Python/Node/Go libraries) for building against Postman's own platform itself, which is what an AI-native builder would need. Missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages/libraries for the Postman API in multiple languages, developer docs showing SDK installation/usage, and independent corroboration of SDK reliability.
